customer_message.subject: Request for help contesting termination of tenancy at Rosenstrasse 45, Schaffhausen
customer_message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to ask for help contesting the termination of my lease for the 3.5-room flat at Rosenstrasse 45 in Schaffhausen. My landlords, Familie Gasser, are ending the tenancy because of unpaid rent. I do not deny that rent is outstanding, but the amount they claim is about CHF 3920 and I need to check how it was calculated.

I have lived in the flat for several years and always paid on time until this year. Last spring I fell behind because an illness kept me from work for several weeks. I have since started repaying the arrears in monthly instalments and am willing to agree a fair repayment plan.

The main problem is the end date. Moving out by then would be a real hardship. Finding an affordable flat in Schaffhausen is very difficult right now and I have not yet found anything suitable. I would therefore like to request an extension of the tenancy so I have enough time to find a new home.

Could you advise me on my options and on how to request a postponement? I can send copies of my payment records and my correspondence with the landlord.

Kind regards,
Dana Pierce
